title: Goblin Brownie
summary: Goblin Brownie is a flag-bearing, diminutive goblin-like Titan. At first glance, Goblin Brownie may seem to present little threat to a larger, more melee-oriented opponent, but this is exactly the image Goblin Brownie wants to convey. Goblin Brownie is capable of using the flags he carries for offense, defense, and even evading traps.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Goblin Brownie Titans influenced the legends behind the goblins and the brownies. Goblins in European lore were known for their mastery of tricks and deception. The brownies appeared in Celtic and European legends as some of the more mischievous fairies. When caught, they would serve as free servants who worked for table scraps for the rest of their captor's life.

Goblin Brownie had been one of the primary Titans used by Simon Judeau during his adventuring days while he traveled with Eathon Lambert and Metz. After Simon donned the alias of "the Professor" and formed the Organization, Goblin Brownie was invoked less frequently as Simon operated from the shadows while afflicted with his curse. [To Be Together]

During the search for the Ring of Tao, while entering King Solomon's mines, Goblin Brownie was invoked alongside Trapfeaster in order to stop a trap that the Professor had triggered within the underground stairway. [To Be Together]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext: Goblin Brownie is able to reset tripped traps by tapping an area affected by the trap with one of his flags in order to disarm them. {{source|To Be Together}} By twisting sigils of magical energy into existence using a pair of enchanted flags from his vast collection, Goblin Brownie can create powerful defensive walls to protect his allies, or conjure curses he can then fire at his enemies. {{source|Huntik.com}} He is also skilled in the art of [[:wikipedia:Bōjutsu|Bōjutsu]], the Japanese martial art of stick fighting, and can spin his poles at incredible speed to create defensive barriers and sheild his Seeker from attacks. {{Source|Huntik Magazine}}

Goblin Brownie is a flag-bearing, diminutive goblin-like Titan. At first glance, Goblin Brownie may seem to present little threat to a larger, more melee-oriented opponent, but this is exactly the image Goblin Brownie wants to convey. Goblin Brownie is capable of using the flags he carries for offense, defense, and even evading traps.

== History ==
Goblin Brownie Titans influenced the legends behind the goblins and the brownies. Goblins in European lore were known for their mastery of tricks and deception. The brownies appeared in Celtic and European legends as some of the more mischievous fairies. When caught, they would serve as free servants who worked for table scraps for the rest of their captor's life.

Goblin Brownie had been one of the primary Titans used by Simon Judeau during his adventuring days while he traveled with Eathon Lambert and Metz. After Simon donned the alias of "the Professor" and formed the Organization, Goblin Brownie was invoked less frequently as Simon operated from the shadows while afflicted with his curse. [To Be Together]

During the search for the Ring of Tao, while entering King Solomon's mines, Goblin Brownie was invoked alongside Trapfeaster in order to stop a trap that the Professor had triggered within the underground stairway. [To Be Together]

== Abilities ==
Goblin Brownie is able to reset tripped traps by tapping an area affected by the trap with one of his flags in order to disarm them. [To Be Together] By twisting sigils of magical energy into existence using a pair of enchanted flags from his vast collection, Goblin Brownie can create powerful defensive walls to protect his allies, or conjure curses he can then fire at his enemies. [Huntik.com] He is also skilled in the art of Bōjutsu, the Japanese martial art of stick fighting, and can spin his poles at incredible speed to create defensive barriers and sheild his Seeker from attacks. [Huntik Magazine]
